name: school-workshop-assigner
description: Fair, capacity- and exclusion-aware assignment of students to workshops (multi-class, tolerant of messy CSV input), powered by the HiGHS solver (WebAssembly).

scripts.build:demo: npm run build && rm -rf demo/vendor && mkdir -p demo/vendor/highs && cp -r dist demo/vendor/school-workshop-assigner && cp node_modules/highs/build/highs.js node_modules/highs/build/highs.wasm demo/vendor/highs/
scripts.demo: npm run build:demo && npx serve demo
